title.narrative: 601 SOCIAL PROTECTION PROGRAMMES FOR CHILDREN, ADOLESCENTS AND THEIR FAMILIES

description.narrative: National, UNICEF programming state governments and other partners have adequate capacity to plan, integrate, implement and monitor social protection programmes for children, adolescents and their families especially addressing marginalized and vulnerable at most critical stages of life cycle and vulnerable situations (*urban slums, climate change impacts, insurgencies) by 2022
